'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event''' was a Players Committee constructed event in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, 3–5 October 2014, using the post-reset virtual pool ([[Open]]). [[Chris Gogolen]] finished 1st.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
* '''Dates:''' 3–5 October 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Gogolen]]
